What do metrics mean?

Precision: How many of those predicted to be of this class are correct?

Recall: How many real flowers in this class did we find?

F1: the harmonious environment of precision and recall.

Conclusion

Even if it turns out 100%, it does not mean that all future data will be infallible. The result is related to the selected test part.

SOURCES AND METHOD

Where did the reports come from?

Iris data was obtained using load_iris() in the scikit-learn library. 150 models, 4 brands, 3 classes.

Train/test: random_state=42, stratify not applied. LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000), other parameters are default. KNN: k=1…20, cv=5, scoring="accuracy". Marks are on the original centimeter scale. No scaling was applied.

Four versions of the test proportion are precomputed in Python. Probabilities for changing flower sizes are calculated in the browser with the coefficients of that model. Animations are visual explanations of steps.
